cohorts.label: Mass point $2k–5k × $2k–10k

cohorts.label: Fresh launches <30m
cohorts.description: Incident state entries observed while the token is younger than 30 minutes; first-seen fresh tokens remain baseline evidence only.

cohorts.label: Dust: < $2k mcap, < $100 liquidity
cohorts.description: Incident entries into the bottom-left corner. Expected to be terminal, but measured prospectively.

cohorts.label: Dormant micro tokens
cohorts.description: Incident entries with no trades in the last hour, stale 30 minutes, and market cap below $5k.

cohorts.label: Deep liquidity, almost no holders
cohorts.description: $10k+ liquidity with at most 10 holders at incident entry.

cohorts.label: Approaching graduation ($50k–250k)
cohorts.description: Incident entries while not graduated in the market-cap band where graduation may occur.

cohorts.label: Crashed into < $1 liquidity
cohorts.description: Incident MOVE into the lowest liquidity region. Does anything recover?
